name: Cores
description: A building's core (corePlan), laid along its local x: [stairwell | left lift bank | lift lobby | right lift bank]. stairs { lane (m, each flight's width), landing } or false; lobby (m wide); banks: each { shafts, shaft { width (m along z), depth (m along x, the door's side to the back wall), tech (m beside the car's run: the technical space with the counterweight at its back and the emergency ladder by the landing doors) }, car { width, depth, height }, door { width, height } }; pit (m below the lowest landing), overrun (m over a car at its top landing), machine (m: the machine room over the overrun); ladder: an emergency ladder up each shaft's technical space; shaftLight { perStorey, y (m over the floor), color, intensity, range (m) } or false: the shaft's own lamps up its technical side wall (a shaft is dark but for them, its lamps seen from end to end).

entities.$comment: a walk-up: stairs only (and a small landing lobby)
